description: Fetch the free masked skill teaser for several traders at once by their opaque masked ids (tids). Same per-trader payload as polyrank_get_trader_by_tid, capped at 10 tids per call. No API key needed. Each result is tagged with its tid, and per-tid failures are returned inline (as an error field) rather than failing the whole batch.

tids.description: Opaque trader ids (tids) from masked rows (max 10).

name: polyrank_get_traders_batch
title: Polyrank trader teasers (batch, by masked id)
